Synopsis:
    Greek PM Mitsotakis ruled out snap elections and confirmed a Spring 2027 general election. His government announced a €3.5B fiscal package (~1.5% of GDP) including income tax cuts, wage hikes, and pension bonuses, to be deployed over four years. Greece is outperforming the Eurozone with 2% GDP growth and a ~4% primary surplus, providing fiscal room for these measures. The ruling party has seen polling support fall below 30% despite leading the opposition.
